title: YouVerify AI quality matrix
note: Statuses describe the commit that contains this file. Validation levels keep unit tests, mocked integrations, real-browser runs against fixture pages, and live provider runs apart; none of them is a substitute for another. Every evidence path is checked to exist by backend/tests/test_quality_matrix.py.

status_legend.PASS: validated by the tests or measurements named in evidence, at the stated validation level
status_legend.FAIL: a verified defect or measured shortfall exists
status_legend.BLOCKED: cannot be validated until the named owner removes a dependency
status_legend.NOT TESTED: no applicable test or measurement was performed
status_legend.NOT APPLICABLE: the requirement does not apply to the current scope

checks.requirement: Builds and tests from a clean clone without hidden configuration
checks.test: Fresh clone, new venv (Python 3.11 and 3.13), npm ci, full suites; CI on every push
checks.observed: All suites pass on Python 3.11 and 3.13 and in GitHub Actions
checks.limitation: Backend dependencies use version ranges without a lock file

checks.requirement: Reproducible backend dependency set
checks.observed: No lock or constraints file: two installs at different times can resolve different versions
checks.limitation: Pin with a constraints file in the deployment image

checks.requirement: No known vulnerabilities in runtime dependencies
checks.implementation: CI job dependency-audit (pip-audit on declared deps, npm audit --omit=dev)
checks.limitation: Point-in-time; GitHub Actions are pinned by tag, not commit SHA

checks.requirement: No secrets in source, history, logs, reports or screenshots
checks.implementation: scripts/scan_secrets.py (CI), redact_secrets for logs and diagnostics
checks.test: Scanner over tracked files and staged changes; full-history scan; redaction tests
checks.observed: 0 findings; the real key is in no commit; .env never committed
checks.limitation: Pattern-based: only known key formats

checks.requirement: The Gemini key pasted into a chat is revoked
checks.implementation: Key rotation in Google AI Studio
checks.test: One live analysis call with the key in .env on 2026-10-15
checks.observed: The call succeeded: the exposed key is still valid
checks.limitation: Only the owner can rotate it

checks.requirement: Correct video id, timestamp, title; Shorts, live streams, ads and non-watch pages refused
checks.test: Unit tests on DOM fixtures; built extension in Chromium on a fixture page
checks.limitation: Fixture DOM, not youtube.com; YouTube can change its markup

checks.requirement: Video changes through YouTube SPA navigation are picked up
checks.implementation: content script yt-navigate-finish listener, panel subscription
checks.test: e2e smoke: pushState + yt-navigate-finish on the fixture page
checks.observed: Pass, also after a service worker restart
checks.limitation: Back/forward, reload and multiple tabs not exercised

checks.requirement: The workflow on real youtube.com in Chrome
checks.test: npm run e2e:live (needs network access to YouTube)
checks.observed: youtube.com is denied in the development sandbox
checks.limitation: Run locally (docs/windows-local-validation.md)

checks.requirement: Seeking, playback speed, buffering, end of video, verify right after seeking
checks.implementation: Position is read from video.currentTime at click time (speed-independent by design)
checks.limitation: Needs real-browser runs on youtube.com

checks.requirement: Private, age-restricted, region-locked or inaccessible videos fail gracefully
checks.implementation: Provider error classification to video_unavailable; manual entry offered
checks.limitation: Live provider wording for each case not observed

checks.requirement: Works after Chrome stops the service worker; no reliance on worker globals
checks.test: e2e smoke stops the worker through DevTools (status verified 'stopped') and requires the video context again
checks.limitation: Extension reload or update mid-verification, browser restart not exercised

checks.requirement: All executable code ships in the package
checks.test: npm run check:remote-code on the built package (CI); verified to fail on an injected violation
checks.limitation: Pattern-based scan

checks.requirement: Minimal permissions and host access
checks.implementation: extension/manifest.json: sidePanel; youtube.com and the local backend
checks.observed: No tabs, storage, scripting, webRequest or <all_urls>
checks.limitation: A deployed backend needs its HTTPS origin added

checks.requirement: Old results cannot overwrite current state; no duplicate paid requests from double clicks
checks.implementation: AbortController supersession, reducer phase guards, start guard (H-11)
checks.test: Race tests; 2000 seeded random action sequences over the reducer
checks.observed: Pass; the double-start defect H-11 was reproduced and fixed
checks.limitation: Two side panels at once not exercised

checks.requirement: Only a clip around the click is processed
checks.observed: Video tokens scaled 2.50x for a 2.50x window, 3/3 pairs
checks.limitation: 3 pairs, 2 videos

checks.requirement: Claim selection and extraction correctness measured
checks.limitation: No accuracy may be reported

checks.requirement: Repeated identical requests give consistent claims
checks.implementation: Single model call; no candidate list
checks.observed: The same request returned different claims and claim types (not quantified)
checks.limitation: Mitigated only by mandatory user confirmation

checks.requirement: Extraction fast enough for an in-video side panel (target under 15 s)
checks.observed: Median 30.9 s, range 20.7-88.5 s (n=4); one 9.7 s run on the fallback model
checks.limitation: Small sample; thinking tokens dominate output

checks.requirement: A model exact-quote flag is never treated as verified transcription
checks.implementation: Flag requires quote text; UI label 'AI transcription (may contain errors)'; verification ignores it
checks.limitation: No independent transcript source

checks.requirement: Evaluate whether candidate lists improve selection
checks.test: None: needs labelled moments to show a benefit
checks.limitation: Deferred until extraction accuracy is measurable

checks.requirement: Russian, English and mixed-language performance compared
checks.implementation: Language hint; claims kept in the spoken language
checks.limitation: No per-language metric

checks.requirement: Opinions, predictions and non-verifiable claims never get a factual verdict
checks.limitation: Depends on the model's classification

checks.requirement: Correct classes for religious, metaphysical, hypothetical, satirical, attributed and health claims
checks.observed: Rules reach the model; compliance unmeasured
checks.limitation: Needs labelled live cases

checks.requirement: An outlet's characterization cannot confirm or refute what someone said
checks.test: 23 synthetic cases + debate fixture; failed before the fix on 82b05a2
checks.limitation: Heuristic (quotation marks, speaker labels), not semantic

checks.requirement: A confident verdict about what someone said needs that person's own words to say it (identity, authenticity and entailment checked separately)
checks.implementation: Entailment stage (entailment.py): one bounded model call judges each claim part against each candidate passage and who is speaking; apply_entailment decides (L-1, issue #6)
checks.test: 24 pipeline cases: L-1, paraphrase, negation, number, date, both-ways, compound, other speaker, snippet-only, RU<->EN, translated quote, check unavailable; L-1 and RU<->EN failed before
checks.limitation: Tests script the model's judgments; whether the live model judges correctly is the separate row below

checks.requirement: The entailment stage's live judgments agree with human labels (entails / contradicts / neutral, speaker identity), including Russian <-> English
checks.test: Not run: no usable model key; no human-labelled attribution passages
checks.limitation: Owner: rotate the key and label attribution cases (docs/annotation-guide.md); measure agreement, cost and latency before relying on it

checks.requirement: Compound claims are judged part by part; partial truth is not 'supported'
checks.implementation: Prompt rules (H-15); proposition-level tooling for evaluation only
checks.test: Prompt contract test; proposition scoring tests (evaluation path)
checks.observed: No runtime decomposition; model compliance unmeasured
checks.limitation: One verdict per claim in the product

checks.requirement: Outage, budget exhaustion, zero results, unreadable pages and irrelevant pages are distinguishable; partial failures visible
checks.test: Retrieval tests with fake providers and mocked pages
checks.limitation: Grounding mode exposes no per-query failures

checks.requirement: Same-site pages and syndicated copies count once
checks.limitation: Different domains of one publisher and outlets citing one study are not detected

checks.requirement: Brave/SearXNG retrieval and page reading work live
checks.observed: No Brave key; publisher sites blocked from the sandbox

checks.requirement: Queries find primary evidence for broad, specific, numerical, cross-language and ambiguous-name claims
checks.implementation: Analysis prompt plans 2-4 queries incl. English
checks.limitation: Needs live search

checks.requirement: Only retrieved URLs are cited; unknown ids are dropped; findings cite only sources assessed as backing them
checks.limitation: Free text in the explanation is not checked against sources

checks.requirement: Verbatim page text, search snippets and model summaries are labelled and never merged
A page mentioning or debunking a claim is not counted as support
checks.limitation: Needs adversarial live cases

checks.requirement: No confident verdict without a source assessed in its direction
checks.test: Unit + property test over all verdict/stance combinations
checks.limitation: Stances themselves are model judgements

checks.requirement: A source assessed both ways cannot back a verdict
A verdict cannot contradict the evaluation's own evidence-backed findings
checks.test: 13 end-to-end scenarios; 2 failed before the fix
checks.limitation: Relies on the model stating the contradicting finding; a silent omission is not caught

checks.requirement: Policy for confident verdicts that rest on one origin whose page was not read
checks.implementation: Warning only ('rests on a single source ...')
checks.test: Prototype downgrade rule changed 5 existing outcomes, incl. default grounding mode
checks.observed: Recall/precision trade-off cannot be measured without labels
checks.limitation: Needs an owner policy decision and labelled data

checks.requirement: Statement date, event period and source dates kept apart
checks.implementation: Evaluator gets today's date and a temporal rule (H-8); chronology check for reference cases
checks.test: Prompt contract test; chronology unit tests
checks.observed: Model compliance unmeasured; the API carries no statement date
checks.limitation: Statement date only via extraction context

checks.requirement: Verdict accuracy and unsupported-confident-verdict rate with sample sizes
checks.test: Needs human-verified labels and a live verdict
checks.observed: 0 human-verified records (6 real moments prepared for review in eval/annotation/cases.jsonl); 0 live verdicts
checks.limitation: No accuracy may be reported

checks.requirement: Model-generated labels cannot pass as human ground truth
checks.implementation: ReferenceRecord validators; EvalItem review status; AnnotationCase keeps machine proposals apart
checks.test: Reference schema tests; accuracy computed only over human-verified items

checks.requirement: Semantic consistency of repeated verifications
checks.limitation: Blocked by the grounding quota

checks.requirement: Malformed, oversized, non-numeric, NaN/Infinity, unicode and extra-field inputs give structured 4xx
checks.implementation: Strict Pydantic schemas, body limit middleware (H-4), invisible-character stripping (H-7)

checks.requirement: TypeScript client types match the API schemas
checks.limitation: Regex parser of types.ts, interfaces only

checks.requirement: No secrets or stack traces reach users
checks.implementation: Typed errors, generic 500 body, diagnostics never returned

checks.requirement: A cancelled request stops its pending model calls
checks.test: Real uvicorn server, client gives up after 0.3 s
checks.observed: Failed before (model call finished), passes after
checks.limitation: A request the provider already accepted may still be billed

checks.requirement: Identical concurrent requests share one model run
checks.limitation: Per process

checks.requirement: Consistent limits, caches and budgets across workers
checks.limitation: Required before a shared deployment

checks.requirement: No fetch of private, loopback, link-local or metadata addresses via any encoding, DNS answer or redirect
checks.test: Mocked-DNS tests; real getaddrinfo matrix; property test over IPv4 encodings
checks.limitation: Names that need DNS could only be tested with mocked resolution here

checks.requirement: Untrusted text (titles, excerpts, claims, context) cannot break out of its delimiter

checks.requirement: Bounded bodies, pages, decompression, redirects, retries, rate-limit memory
checks.implementation: Body limit (H-4), fetch caps, rate limiter purge (H-5)
checks.limitation: In-memory caches are bounded by entry count, not bytes

checks.requirement: Anonymous-access abuse, shared budgets, HTTPS, auth for a public deployment
Chrome Web Store policies: single purpose, disclosures, privacy policy, data handling
checks.test: Checklist only; no listing or review
checks.observed: Several items need developer-account and legal action

checks.requirement: Progress and results announced; errors as alerts; reduced motion respected
checks.implementation: Live regions, role=alert, focus to verdict (H-16)

checks.requirement: Russian interface

checks.requirement: Verification latency p50/p95, tokens, searches and cost per check

checks.requirement: CI runs lint, format, types, tests, build, secret scan, link check, dependency audit, remote-code check and a real-browser smoke test
